dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Cardinal Seamus is currently dealing with other matters, and we have taken over some administrative duties in the meantime... He was basically the only person taking care of everything before we stepped in.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Nannina, Laurent, and I have been taking turns to cover for him. But, try as we might, it is often difficult to keep up.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: They say that Master Jean, who stayed behind in Mondstadt, handles virtually all of the Knights' affairs, big and small... It really is a case of like father, like daughter.
